name: TFT35-E3 V3.0
description: A 3.5 inch dual-mode color TFT display designed for Ender-3 printers. In Klipper, operates in 12864 emulation mode via EXP1/EXP2. The color touch mode is Marlin-only. Features EXP3 for single-cable connection to E3 series boards in addition to standard EXP1/EXP2.
features: Designed for Ender-3 and similar printers
EXP3 connector for single-cable connection to E3 series boards
